answer: AI economies resist Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to bond a significant, scarce resource stake, establishing a foundational identity trellis. New agents initially gain influence only through a small whisper network, requiring positive contributions to earn broader trust. This slow reputational growth, combined with stake slashing for malicious acts, ensures the financial and temporal cost to effectively ripple multiple useful Sybil identities through the system becomes prohibitively high for an attacker.
